name: family-drawer
title: Family Drawer
description: A bottom-anchored drawer that opens from a Share button with a title, description and large action rows. Choosing an action swaps the sheet to a second view, such as a copied-link confirmation, and resizes to fit.
use: A few share or action choices should appear from the bottom edge without leaving the page.
avoid: The drawer is capped at 361px wide and a few short views, so dense forms or wide tables do not fit.
a11y: The icon-only close button has no aria-label, and the view swaps are not announced to screen readers. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A narrow dark sheet rises from the bottom of a dimmed page with large rounded corners. It holds a small icon, a bold title, a grey description, two full-width muted rows with icons, and a plain Cancel line; an X sits at the top right.
behaves: The Share button slides the sheet up from the bottom. Choosing Copy link or Send via email fades and scales the content into a new view while the sheet's height animates to fit; Cancel or the overlay closes it.
customise: Root takes views, open, defaultView and change callbacks; each view is built from the exported header, button and wrapper parts. Colours follow theme tokens.
weight: moderate: A measured bottom sheet with view transitions; light, but it pulls several dependencies.
